notes.zh-CN: 桌面输入框「转为英文」默认通过 DeepSeek Harness 使用 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash。可在「设置 → 模型 → 翻译模型」切换到 DeepSeek V4 Pro。macOS 为 universal 开发签名，未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: The desktop composer translates drafts with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash through DeepSeek Harness by default. Choose DeepSeek V4 Pro under Settings → Models → Translation model. The universal macOS app has a development signature and is unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK has a debug signature. The iOS IPA has a development signature and installs on registered team devices.
